title: Faking versus reading in the old days
summary: He says older players mostly faked, whereas younger musicians now learn properly.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Reading music versus faking and playing by ear

blocks.x: Yeah. You used to fake a good deal more than you started.

Oh yes. Well, that was practically the trend around there. If I listened to the guys, if you listened to the guys, you wouldn't even want to listen. Yeah, that's right. If you listened to the older guys, the majority of the old guys, you wouldn't hardly want to listen even. No kidding. Because if it don't be familiar, I don't guess I'd ever want to listen. Not in that era, because they were music conscious, which nowadays the guys, the youngsters, they have a better advantage of that. They don't do that anymore. Yeah. The majority of the kids, they want to learn the proper way, and in fact, most everybody goes out to learn the proper way. But in those days, there were so many of them, they didn't fool around with any music at all. So they just figured since they was planning on making money and wasn't planning or didn't know anything about music, they just thought it was all right. They take it for granted that way, you see. But later years, people began moving and moving around, meeting different companies and everything like that, you see.
